BrowserEndpointRegistration.description:
A browser endpoint identity is tied to a management-authenticated registration
challenge and receives a fixed, server-enforced ten-minute lifetime.
BrowserEndpointRegistration.title: BrowserEndpointRegistration

BrowserHostReadiness.description: A host-signed preparation hint. This grants no capture or session authority.
BrowserHostReadiness.title: BrowserHostReadiness

native_ice_version.description: Optional native ICE signaling dialect. Absent on older deployments.

MediaAnnouncementSubmission.description: Separate endpoints preserve the exact legacy registration/request JSON.
MediaAnnouncementSubmission.title: MediaAnnouncementSubmission

NativeDiscoveryConfig.description:
Discovery inputs supplied by the authenticated, pinned deployment. Local
private-network consent is deliberately absent from this response.
NativeDiscoveryConfig.title: NativeDiscoveryConfig

NetworkAuthorityChangeRequest.description:
Deployment-admin compare-and-swap. Keys are derived on the server; a remote
response never authorizes changing an operator's locally pinned key.
NetworkAuthorityChangeRequest.title: NetworkAuthorityChangeRequest

NetworkAuthorityRequest.description: Deployment-administrator controls. These never grant business or IP access.
NetworkAuthorityRequest.title: NetworkAuthorityRequest

NetworkGrantView.description:
Exact canonical claims and signature, base64url without padding. Keep these
credentials out of logs, telemetry, events and diagnostic views.

NetworkRemoteRelayRequest.title: NetworkRemoteRelayRequest

NodeResourceQueryClaims.description: A node-signed query, bounded by its already authenticated policy lease.

PermitClaims.description: No account login token or device ID alone authorizes this resource.

media_formats.description: Strict canonical VideoFormat v2, 57 bytes each.

allowed_sources.description: An empty list denies all visitors; /0 is an explicit public choice.

ServiceIngress.description: Requested ingress only. Creating or approving a record opens no listener.

choice_revision.description: Original local choice revision; its digest must not be recomputed at N+1.

edge_service_address.description: Canonical operator-approved service QUIC endpoint, signed with the lease.

service_revision.description: Current registry revision, after independent target approval.

usage_grant.description:
Immutable per-publication byte authority; renewed leases carry the
same signed grant byte-for-byte.

ServiceQuotaScope.description:
Aggregate service quota dimensions. Keys are immutable UUID strings and
are bound into every grant and report so callers cannot change scope on a
retry or terminal seal.

reconciliation_required.description: Restored snapshots cannot establish complete lifetime usage on their own.

ServiceResourceGrant.description:
Resource authentication is unchanged; this outer response also supplies a
separately policy-signed issuer delegation for the host renewal stream.
ServiceResourceGrant.title: ServiceResourceGrant

service_lease_issuer.description: Delegated by the already trusted independent node-policy issuer.

target_sha256.description: Commits to the actual locally selected, fixed address and target protocol.

ice.description:
Cumulative, bounded ICE snapshot. Every revision retains its original
description so polling cannot deliver candidates without their parent.

native_ice.description:
Endpoint-signed credentials for the native Quinn/ICE dialect. It is
independent of browser SDP and never replaces a business permission.

rendezvous.description:
Address-free native rendezvous through each endpoint's trusted
management origin. This declaration grants no target or business right.

SignedServiceResourceQuery.description: Uses the existing bounded node query fields with an independent signature purpose.
SignedServiceResourceQuery.title: SignedServiceResourceQuery

SpaceInvitationIssued.description: The secret is returned exactly once and must be cleared when the UI closes.
SpaceInvitationIssued.title: SpaceInvitationIssued

active.description: Current rule and approved-target facts; this does not claim ingress readiness.

post.x-node-close-proof: SignedRelayClose signed by the allocated node key and bound to the exact allocation, runtime, security epoch and stable grant binding. Terminal cleanup facts release only that promise, without granting forwarding authority; exact retries return the immutable signed acknowledgement

get.x-node-key-proof: NodeChallenge/NodeProof signed with the registered node key before any policy lease is issued

get.x-node-relay-proof: NodeRelayChallenge / NodeRelayHello prove the allocated endpoint key, original signed allocation, selected WSS transport and fresh socket challenge before pairing; no management bearer or plaintext media is sent to the node

post.x-node-usage-proof: SignedNodeUsage signed with the registered node key, bound to the current runtime, security epoch and policy lease; bearer tokens do not authorize reports

post.x-node-resource-proof: SignedNodeResourceQuery signed with the registered node key, bound to a live runtime/epoch/policy lease and a short request-specific expiry; bearer tokens cannot substitute for the signature

post.x-node-service-resource-proof: SignedServiceResourceQuery signed with the registered node key, bound to the current runtime, security epoch, policy lease, monotonic query sequence and request-specific expiry; the independent node-policy key signs the service resource response. Management bearer tokens cannot replace this proof

post.x-node-service-usage-proof: SignedServiceUsageReport signed with the registered node key and bound to the exact immutable service grant, node runtime, security epoch, cumulative counters and report sequence. The independent node-policy issuer signs an acknowledgement of the exact report digest; byte-identical retries are idempotent. Management bearer tokens cannot substitute for this proof

post.x-node-service-usage-stop-proof: SignedServiceUsageRuntimeStop signed with the allocated node key after the exact publication flows and attachment have drained, binding the final acknowledged report digest and exact cumulative counters. HTTP 204 follows a durable terminal seal; only remaining commitment is released and reported spend remains charged. Byte-identical retries are idempotent and bearer tokens do not authorize the seal

post.x-node-turn-resource-proof: SignedTurnResourceQuery signed with the registered node key, bound to a live runtime/epoch/policy lease and request-specific expiry; the response is signed with the independent node-policy key and peer bindings require both endpoint signatures
